plan.passage_plan_scope: only passage/batch/provenance validation; its old arm list is not executed

passage_plan.batch_layout: little-endian int32 [2, passage_count, context_length]; inputs then targets
limitations: Native full-corpus IDs are authoritative; windows are not retokenized.
The current suffix is not authenticated historical held-out data.
Forward loss evaluation is validation, not weight-only extraction.

checkpoint.source_hash_scope: Current analysis source, not authenticated checkpoint producer
checkpoint.checkpoint_metadata: None: dtype, byte order, and architecture are caller assumptions

tensors.name: token_embedding.weight
tensors.role: Token embedding and tied LM output dictionary

passage_plan.native_byte_validation: every token checked against its exact original byte interval

run_metadata.layout: little-endian; input and target halves; passage-major outputs; W2 rows are input features
run_metadata.integrity_hashes: external frozen planner/reporter hashes input, groups, binary and checkpoint before/after

discovery.floor_scope: FP64 diagnostic only, not GPU noise or interval bound

limitations: Known corpus inputs, not analytically extracted text.
Within-passage disjoint target confirmation, not independent documents.
Projected residuals mix all groups/passages; raw finite interventions alone are causal effects.
Removing one discovery mode neither eliminates all confounds nor preserves all memories.
All selection and ranking is descriptive; no p-values or unique/minimal storage claims.
